    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233

filtered_items_books AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item

),
filtered_items_children AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Children' AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')
),
filtered_items_electronics AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics' AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')
),
filtered_items_women AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Women' AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
),
filtered_items_music AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Music' AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
),
filtered_items_men AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Men' AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
)
SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
FROM (SELECT * FROM filtered_items_books UNION ALL SELECT * FROM filtered_items_children UNION ALL SELECT * FROM filtered_items_electronics UNION ALL SELECT * FROM filtered_items_women UNION ALL SELECT * FROM filtered_items_music UNION ALL SELECT * FROM filtered_items_men) AS all_filtered_items
JOIN filtered_sales ON filtered_sales.ss_item_sk = all_filtered_items.i_item_sk
WHERE sum_sales * 1.1 < avg_monthly_sales * 1.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
